findings.observation: Users could not distinguish startup work from a hang, and full dependency hashing delayed ordinary launches.
findings.rule: Report actual launcher stages; validate downloaded archives when installing; reuse an installed version after checking its receipt, version and required startup entries.
findings.reason: Applies to all launches, independent of story or artwork.

findings.observation: Manga requests should find the installed workflow without naming the skill; existing method choices must not be asked again.
findings.rule: Offer MCP first only when the method is unspecified, respect explicit alternatives and reuse an accepted choice.
findings.reason: Covers first use, explicit invocation and resumed production.

findings.observation: A one-page request needs the same production and save flow without an extra cover.
findings.rule: Use totalPages 1, keep a requested title on that page, and retain concrete-plan review, materials and PNG/JSON checks.
findings.reason: Page count is distinct from panel count.

findings.observation: A cover described only in the brief was initially planned as a normal comic page.
findings.rule: Set page kind, panel count and presentation before the first story-planning operation.
findings.reason: Verified against the corrected live MCP outline; does not hardcode a particular title, author or page count.

findings.observation: Production lessons can be lost between releases.
findings.rule: Review actual production and feedback at each deployment, generalize useful steps, separate application bugs from skill instructions and bind the review to the candidate skill.
findings.reason: The release check verifies record presence and consistency, not the truth of its content or future generation quality.

findings.observation: A specific romance title, cast, dialogue and camera details belong to this work.
findings.rule: Do not turn story-specific names, dialogue or incidental geometry into universal skill rules.
findings.reason: Preserves creative flexibility and the user acceptance standard for minor visual differences.

findings.observation: A page-level plot summary did not give the user enough detail to review the story.
findings.rule: Display the saved detailed plan as panel-by-panel scenes, actions, expressions, named dialogue and ending; retain exact story content while hiding unnecessary internal JSON and coordinates.
findings.reason: Applies to both one-page and multipage proposals and revisions.

findings.observation: A temporary production tab was not retained before a turn ended, losing its in-memory API connection.
findings.rule: Use the client documented tab retention or handoff operation before ending a production or approval-wait turn, and reapply turn-scoped marks when necessary.
findings.reason: The project on disk and the browser-only connection have different lifetimes.

findings.observation: An outline could contradict the last-page watermark override because the authoring request omitted effective per-page settings.
findings.rule: Keep page display overrides in the actual planning input and compare narrative directions to those settings before presenting the plan.
findings.reason: Application prompt construction was corrected with a regression test; this is not solved solely by longer skill text. The currently connected released app remains on its existing build; this project outline was aligned through its normal MCP plan-edit operation.

findings.observation: The user asked the skill to apply the locally installed Story Maker storytelling knowledge, beyond operating the manga MCP.
findings.rule: Design reader expectations, scale structure to page count, track motivation and information, plan setup/payoff, express feelings through drawable acting, and preserve the current draft when a revision causes regression.
findings.reason: Extracted actual prompt/review/candidate-adoption mechanisms; excluded mandatory novel lengths, fixed beat counts, numeric score loops and extra provider calls. Approved drafts are not revised retroactively.

findings.observation: An image visible inside a tool result or application was insufficient for the user to see each finished artifact in the conversation.
findings.rule: Inspect and display each completed character sheet and page inline in conversation as it becomes available, with a clear label and verified file; track per-page checkpoints during batch rendering and keep a record of shown images.
findings.reason: The actual two character sheets and first saved cover were embedded while the book job was still running; no all-pages wait is required.

findings.observation: Earlier static skill reviews did not prevent an unearned opening confession or contradictory public/private information.
findings.rule: Construct from reader expectations and character choices, then separately inspect causal validity and reader experience using actual panel evidence.
findings.reason: Changed construction workflow and added concrete negative-case review; merely delaying a confession or adding check labels is insufficient.

findings.observation: Drawing directions duplicated application responsibilities, while users wanted the skill to specialize in scripts.
findings.rule: Keep style and rendering-prompt construction in the app; use a separate conditional MCP handoff reference for authorized production.
findings.reason: Preserves existing display/save/stop behavior without imposing an additional drawing policy.

findings.observation: Other PCs may not have Story Maker, and future works may be medium or long rather than only one-page or short romance.
findings.rule: Bundle independently worded methods, scale/series guidance, original exercises and attributed source notes; no Story Maker or live web requirement for normal scripting.
findings.reason: Knowledge is in the installed resource files; source research and practical testing are separate from weight training or human reader evaluation.

findings.observation: Length must be chosen from user instructions or asked, not silently guessed when unspecified.
findings.rule: Honor exact/prior counts; use stated working defaults32/64/192 for short/medium/long labels; ask and wait when both page count and label are absent.
findings.reason: Defaults are explicit skill choices, not universal publishing definitions, and do not override app operation limits or authorize image spending.

findings.observation: A substantive rewrite changed the central joke but initially retained the former title; the user explicitly pointed this out.
findings.rule: Reconsider title suitability whenever the story changes; retain it when it still fits. For a title change, align the proposal, cover lettering, project name and synopsis without automatically regenerating preserved old art.
findings.reason: Applied to the current v2 draft through normal MCP edits; project name, outline title, cover direction and brief were read back with the same new title. Images remain stopped.

findings.observation: Production preflight found that project/outline/cover prose had the new title but the actual cover presentation.logoText still held the former title.
findings.rule: On retitling, update and read back the actual cover logoText with the other title representations, then check detail/prompt before images.
findings.reason: Corrected through normal manga_page_update before the resumed production; earlier broad title-alignment report omitted this field and was corrected to the user.

findings.observation: User requires ongoing skill-derived bug learning, explicit separation from app bug repairs and special care around conflicting skill/app instructions.
findings.rule: Update generalizable skill causes when fixed, classify app versus skill versus shared-boundary causes, and compare approved story/effective settings/generated instructions without duplicating drawing policy.
findings.reason: The missed cover logo field is a skill handoff check; incorrect cover render-options metadata is an app code fix with a failing-before regression. These are recorded separately.

findings.observation: User requires portable pen-name handling for other users rather than a fixed example author.
findings.rule: For a new manga with image production, including one-page and coverless works, ask once for this work's pen name or no-credit choice if unspecified. Do not add questions for script-only work, same-work resume or an existing answer; never infer another user's name or add a cover/all-page credit automatically.
findings.reason: The current work keeps its explicitly supplied author. Pen-name collection is distinct from deciding which page carries the credit, and there is no fixed global author.

findings.observation: A saved revised plan and approval did not establish effective image inputs: the application could retain an older page snapshot, and the production check failed to inspect scenario and finalPrompt before rendering.
findings.rule: After apply_page, inspect actual snapshot.scenario; after prompt, inspect actual snapshot.finalPrompt and render-options against the currently approved story, title, author, dialogue and settings before image submission. Inspect the resulting image separately.
findings.reason: The app state-precedence bug needs an application repair and normal-path verification. This skill change addresses the separate handoff-check omission; it neither rewrites drawing policy nor requires reapproval of unchanged approved content. Plan hashes, filenames and snapshot stubs are insufficient evidence.

findings.observation: Prompt review missed a conflict between a scenario-present silent/background character and the generated cast-count/exclusion directives.
findings.rule: Before image submission, compare scenario presence, including silent and background characters, with generated character counts and exclusions.
findings.reason: This strengthens the separate review procedure. Alias resolution remains an application responsibility; the skill does not replace it, rewrite every name to a full name, impose drawing constraints or prove generation quality.

findings.observation: Per-page progress images became difficult to find after activity was collapsed.
findings.rule: Show each completed page during production and re-embed every accepted page in reading order in the final answer; avoid details blocks and link-only delivery. Keep a complete reading index. Do not claim a skill changed the host app history-collapse setting. Reuse the saved original PNGs and proven inline method; no Adobe/other transformation service or new image generation for presentation.
findings.reason: Separate interim and final presentation records; apply to1P and multipage image delivery, not script-only work or unfinished pages. Respect explicit alternative display requests and real client limits.

findings.observation: Completed manga needs an optional SNS-sharing handoff with explicit destination and concrete post approval.
findings.rule: After final delivery ask sharing intent once; resolve SNS/account/audience, reuse or establish supported connection, propose complete intro/text and accepted page order, publish only the approved concrete plan, verify live post and URL, inspect uncertain results before retry.
findings.reason: Portable across users and platforms; no fixed account, author, image limit or promotional links. Skill-only/script-only/draft-only/declined requests do not publish. Existing valid concrete approval is retained; app release announcement policy is separate.

findings.observation: The sharing workflow lacked the required final AI-production disclosure.
findings.rule: Append the specified sentence after hashtags and links on each platform and each post; include it in length checks and pre/post-publish readback. If supplied work was made differently, propose truthful wording for approval.
findings.reason: Portable posting convention; not a fixed author or story setting. No claim of publication or technical enforcement.

findings.observation: Retitled work もう一回、好きって言って。 remained in その告白、全館放送中です！_20261117_090308; uncontrolled Explorer opening interrupted file operations.
findings.rule: Include actual work-folder name in retitle alignment; prefer supported save migration and read back paths/files/references without disrupting running jobs. Never silently claim alignment when capability is missing. Do not unsolicitedly open Explorer or uncontrolled native dialogs; directly inspect files/API and guide necessary user operations. Controlled filechooser/setFiles uploads remain allowed.
findings.reason: User requested future skill behavior only. No existing output folder or application code was changed; the instructions retain app rendering ownership, current approvals and accepted-page presentation.

findings.observation: Multi-page final-page right watermark differed from normal one-page wording.
findings.rule: Use current one-page application canonical wording for matching engine/model/quality/version; compare actual finalPrompt and visible output, never invent text from title or author or freeze a duplicate in the skill. Respect showWatermarks:false; keep ending, page number and author logo separate.
findings.reason: Future instruction change only. No old-work regeneration or application repair. Existing artwork-overlap tolerance remains authoritative.

findings.observation: Existing five character sheets are a local condition and must not become a portable default.
findings.rule: For new image production with no chosen source, ask supplied/obtained/user-designated sheets versus AI generation; reuse existing choices on resume, never silently choose local sheets or universalize counts/names/paths.
findings.reason: Current explicit usual-five request needs no new question. Script-only work is excluded; external source, permission and authentication uncertainty remain unverified.

findings.observation: Sheet uniforms were inherited without a sheet-exact request, despite a different story setting.
findings.rule: Separate identity from clothing. Prioritize explicit sheet-exact clothing; otherwise design/propose story-, setting- and role-appropriate shared clothing, preserve it across pages and make explicit changes page-specific. Pass approved outfit through supported customOutfit and scenario; inspect effective scenario/prompt for stale sheet-clothing conflicts.
findings.reason: Portable story/setting decision, without fixing current characters or costumes as defaults or adding drawing-style policy. Same approved outfit repair does not need reapproval.

findings.observation: The skill needed an explicit distinction between sheet-specified behavior and creative completion of missing traits.
findings.rule: Reflect sheet personality, speech, values, relationships, habits and action tendencies in choices/dialogue. Keep personality across costume changes. Creatively supplement unspecified fictional traits from appearance, role and story, label supplements separately and retain consistency. Explicit user changes prevail.
findings.reason: No exhaustive missing-field questionnaire, fixed cast or real-person trait inference. Shared character settings and effective scenario/prompt carry the approved characterization.

findings.observation: Prior SNS rule placed disclosure last and prohibited fixed links generally; outfit text did not establish a shown/confirmed costume reference image.
findings.rule: Final two SNS lines are exact disclosure then designated plain URL, with nothing appended. For costume changes show and confirm identity-preserving outfit image before story production, reuse a matching existing image and assign that same image as actual story reference.
findings.reason: Reconciles conflicting prior last-line/link wording. Preserve valid concrete approvals, original sheet identity/personality and artwork tolerance; exclude script-only, unnecessary sheet-exact changes, old-post modifications and unsupported unreferenced replacement generation.

findings.observation: Extending only the tail to reach the correct speaker created an excessive cross-panel connection.
findings.rule: Review actual balloon-to-speaker connection; move the balloon body into suitable space near the head/mouth and use a short natural tail, with local shape/line-break adjustment when necessary. Preserve dialogue content, reading order, faces, hands and required actions.
findings.reason: No numeric limit, fixed cast, coordinates or drawing-style policy. Respect explicit distant-speech staging and coherent minor variation. This is production review/handoff, not an app code repair.

findings.observation: A local tail correction left unbalanced empty space in the full panel.
findings.rule: After balloon relocation inspect full-panel character placement, whitespace distribution, gaze flow and density. Balance balloon body, characters and space jointly while preserving speaker, natural tail, reading order and necessary actions.
findings.reason: Avoid local-only acceptance without treating all whitespace as a defect; retain deliberate pauses, quiet and compositional negative space. Instruction/handoff improvement only.

findings.observation: Restoring only a downstream prompt after continuity invalidation left the page unprepared.
findings.rule: Read downstream prepared state and current continuity references after earlier-page/material edits; use normal instruction assembly if invalidated. Do not restore only old prompts or fabricate confirmation flags. Valid official restoration may be reused only with actual input/reference/normal-guard agreement.
findings.reason: Retain reusable unchanged content without requiring completed-page regeneration after an isolated failure. Application invalidation is functioning as intended.

findings.observation: A character appeared to look away from the important action target.
findings.rule: Inspect actual gaze, face and necessary body orientation against attack/watch/conversation/view targets; locally repair concrete mismatches. Permit movement away while watching a threat, natural twists and intentional surprise or backward looks.
findings.reason: Do not mechanically face every character toward enemies or force rear views. Preserve personality, intended staging and coherent minor variation; no new drawing policy or application checker change.

findings.observation: The production operator misidentified the user-referenced page as BODY1; the actual target was BODY3 final panel.
findings.rule: Before local edits match target page, panel and latest adopted image to user feedback. Resolve ambiguity from recent displayed images and utterances instead of assuming an older page.
findings.reason: Correct individual evidence without deleting history or changing the valid generic gaze rule. Actual BODY3 correction remains incomplete; no correction success asserted.

findings.observation: Local limb correction alone may miss a simultaneous reach/depth problem in the same attack.
findings.rule: Inspect actual body connections and necessary limbs jointly with relative scale/depth, weapon reach/contact and action result. Recheck the whole action after local repair.
findings.reason: Permit readable perspective exaggeration, natural occlusion and foot bleed; do not enforce fixed scale or infer a defect solely from obscured connections. This is review/handoff guidance, not application checker redefinition.

findings.observation: Distance inconsistency remained after automatic repair and could be disguised by implausible weapon elongation.
findings.rule: Keep approved props and body proportions while correcting position/depth/contact; do not hide reach mismatch through abnormal weapon extension or unnatural actor/target scaling. Explicit magical extension is an exception.
findings.reason: Integrated into existing body/action-distance guidance without adding fixed geometry or rejecting readable stylization. Current image repair is not complete.

findings.observation: A local upper-panel layout repair clipped required ending lettering in a different panel.
findings.rule: After local image editing inspect the full page, including non-target dialogue, specified ending lettering, page number and standard footer, for lost/clipped requested content. Verify explicitly requested readable text while respecting existing footer-art-priority and intentional-occlusion permissions.
findings.reason: Do not accept from target crop alone or impose universal text visibility. Existing ending-placement order and accepted artwork remain authoritative; current ending repair is pending.

findings.observation: Panel resizing changes whole-page composition beyond the edited panel and preserved lettering.
findings.rule: After panel size/boundary/area changes inspect full-page panel allocation, size contrast, character/negative-space/black-white balance, reading order and gaze flow along with requested lettering. Never accept solely from edited panel.
findings.reason: Integrated into existing whole-page post-edit check; preserves intentional asymmetry, whitespace, bleed and user acceptance. No duplicate universal layout or visibility mandate.

findings.observation: Ending-letter checks must not implicitly require endings on intermediate pages.
findings.rule: Check ending presence/placement/loss only on final page; common page checks cover composition, reading flow, dialogue and that page’s explicitly requested display elements.
findings.reason: Never demand or add 完/END on intermediate pages. Full-page balance review remains common to all pages.

findings.observation: A fixed ending-word list and dialogue-only review would miss other adopted endings and informative lettering.
findings.rule: Compare role-bearing page lettering against approved script and pre-edit accepted image for loss/clipping/occlusion/read-order changes. On final page inspect the adopted/specified ending literally; named examples are not an exhaustive list.
findings.reason: Integrated with full-page composition review. Preserve intentional effect-text crop and footer hiding when important information survives; add neither new words nor universal glyph safe-area rules.

findings.observation: A hidden working screen was treated as a user navigation problem despite surviving connected tabs.
findings.rule: Do not close/hide working screens or connected tabs without explicit instruction or justified need. Locate and display the target through tab inventory, URL and actual project/page/job screen state; distinguish hidden panel from removed tab or API disconnect.
findings.reason: Preserve unsaved/authenticated state and resolve duplicate URLs by content. Explain only genuine required user operations; no document-level technical enforcement or automatic-recovery guarantee.

findings.observation: Skill-only updates could remain local and release notices could omit evidence images.
findings.rule: Include skill-only updates in deployment and synchronize app bundle, separate skill ZIP, installed copies and distribution descriptions. Authorized release announcements attach relevant current reference images showing changes; no unnecessary image generation.
findings.reason: Valid release-specific permission remains required. Distinguish release announcements from completed-work posting. No publication, commit, packaging or deployment performed by this document subtask.

findings.observation: Successful upload did not establish that a native file selection window had disappeared.
findings.rule: Do not probe upload entry without starting the supported filechooser waiter. Do not infer dialog disappearance from attachment success or window inventory; inspect native actual state when residue is suspected. Keep existing prohibition on uncontrolled filepicker opening.
findings.reason: Minimal integration into existing file-selection section, without assuming window creation cause or diagnosing uninvestigated artwork bleed.
